long_biography.plain_text:
After studying mathematics at the Chinese University of Hong Kong, Li worked as a merchant before entering real estate in 1993. The following year he and Zhang Li established the business that became Guangzhou R&F Properties. It first developed housing in Guangzhou before broadening the platform across mainland China and overseas markets.

R&F's Hong Kong listing in 2005 gave the founders a public-market vehicle. The group later combined residential development with investment properties, offices, shopping centres and hotel assets. As chairman, Li retained responsibility for strategic direction, sales and finance while serving as an executive director and substantial shareholder.
long_biography.html:
After studying mathematics at the Chinese University of Hong Kong, Li worked as a merchant before entering real estate in 1993. The following year he and Zhang Li established the business that became Guangzhou R&F Properties. It first developed housing in Guangzhou before broadening the platform across mainland China and overseas markets.

R&F's Hong Kong listing in 2005 gave the founders a public-market vehicle. The group later combined residential development with investment properties, offices, shopping centres and hotel assets. As chairman, Li retained responsibility for strategic direction, sales and finance while serving as an executive director and substantial shareholder.
